messages:
Alex Wong: kicking off the marketplace onboarding for AWS / GCP / Azure. need owners for SKU mapping, artifact hosting, and the listing legal copy. who can own end-to-end?

Priya Nair: I can own IAM + artifact bucket setup. plan: terraform module for cross-account roles + bucket policies. will add CI role for uploads only.

Marco Ruiz: i'll handle SKU <-> meter ID mapping and the publisher portal entries for GCP/Azure. note: Azure requires offerId (GUID), planId, and meter dimension ids. AWS needs product code + sku. i'll share a mapping template.

Priya Nair: draft AWS role policy (minimal):
```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {"Effect":"Allow","Action": ["s3:PutObject", "s3:GetObject"], "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::redwood-marketplace-artifacts/*"},
    {"Effect":"Allow","Action": ["sts:AssumeRole"], "Principal": {"Service": "marketplace.amazonaws.com"}}
  ]
}
```
Use presigned PUTs for large uploads.

Emilio Park: infra note: for GCP we'll use signed URL uploads to GCS to avoid complex IAM cross-project perms. for Azure, i'll provision a storage account & container and hand over SAS token rotation automation.

Dana Chen: legal: confirm trial length displayed in portal and the EULA snippet. any billing trial (free credits) needs explicit terms. also need to know if we publish an SLA in the listing.

Alex Wong: product decision: show a 14-day free trial for the SaaS offering, and list metered tiers for usage beyond trial. we don't publish SLA in the public listing (enterprise customers will sign separate SOW).

Dana Chen: OK. i'll prepare the short trial addendum and the UI-facing one-line liability text. will post to ticket MP-4988.

marketplace-bot: Created ticket MP-4988: "Marketplace onboarding: artifacts, SKUs, EULA" assigned to @Priya Nair. https://tracker.redwood.ai/MP-4988

Marco Ruiz: uploaded sample CSV to MP-4988: columns = cloud, offer_id, plan_id, sku_code, meter_id, price_unit. Azure rows must include offer GUIDs.

Priya Nair: opened terraform PR: https://git.redwood.ai/pr/marketplace/78 includes aws_role, gcs_bucket, and azure_storage. added variable for kms_key and requester_pays flag.

Emilio Park: i'll add a small lambda that mints STS creds and returns a presigned PUT for AWS; for GCS i'll add a signed URL endpoint. rotation for Azure SAS token will be 30d by default.

Alex Wong: timeline check: want vendor portal drafts uploaded by next Wednesday EOD. is that tight?

Marco Ruiz: doable if legal copy is in by Monday and infra land by Tuesday.

Dana Chen: i'll target Monday EOD for EULA copy and trial addendum.

Priya Nair: i'll finish terraform + lambda and merge by Tuesday morning. tagging @eng-sre for the rollout.

Eng Oncall Bot: scheduled maintenance 2025-10-02 02:00-04:00 UTC. reply with "reschedule" if you need a different window.

Alex Wong: thanks team. i'll consolidate owners/timeline in MP-4988 and follow up with screenshots for the portal fields we need to fill. :rocket:
